text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, when fixes are cheap and easy. This saves the team time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing: reviewers learn new techniques, and authors receive useful feedback. Moreover, regular reviews improve team quality, because everyone follows the same standards and writes cleaner code. In short, code reviews are not just about finding mistakes—they help teams communicate, learn, and build better software together.
